prompt:
Photorealistic editorial photograph, 16:9 widescreen.
Subject: a stylish Korean office worker in her early thirties with a sleek chin-length bob, wearing a cream oversized knit sweater under a camel trench coat, a small crossbody bag, holding her smartphone at chest height at a subway ticket gate. She looks caught off guard: eyebrows slightly raised, eyes wide, lips parted, frozen for a second, as if someone just asked her a question in English. Modern, trendy, natural makeup. Her face is sharp and placed on the right third of the frame, looking toward the left.
Foreground left: the out-of-focus shoulder and back of a foreign tourist with a backpack, holding up a phone with a map, leaning in to ask. Only the back and shoulder are visible, no face.
Setting: a clean, bright, modern Seoul-style subway concourse with ticket gates and tiled floor. Every sign, screen and map is softly blurred and completely unreadable.
Lighting: soft cool daylight mixed with warm overhead station light, natural skin tones, gentle contrast, contemporary magazine look.
Shot: eye-level, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field. The left half of the frame is soft, calm and uncluttered so a headline can be placed there later.
Text: absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no Hangul, no signage characters anywhere in the image.
No watermark, no AI logos, no Gemini logo or sparkle icons, clean corners without stamps or overlays, ultra-clean edges.
